{"notes": "Visit 4 (6:15). Picture: all dominoes dark, so everything is connected. Both body lines, both tail fin tips (upper ~(28,6), lower ~(28,13.8)) and the crossing at x=23-24 look clean, with no gaps or stray pieces. Team is hands-off with time to spare. Claims match the picture (97/97).

Sofia: Private report matches the picture. She laid the belly and says she checked the whole chain with Hana. Offered to restand only a knocked spot, which is sound risk judgment. Strong on collaboration and communication, and execution looks good. Her check is only partly independent, since she mostly echoes Hana. Her account of the work is consistent across visits.

Omar: Public update was accurate (fish facing left, both tips connected, time to spare) and credited teammates. Supportive and upbeat, but still follows more than leads. He never raised the pale cluster at the crossing, and I can't credit him for the fix.

Hana: Claims match the picture. She relaid the lower fin to get the angle right and says the team double-checked it. Her hands-off, fix-only-if-reported stance is good judgment. Remains the strongest on impact and leadership. Still unexplained: why she relaid the lower fin when it looked clean last visit, and whether that replaced Jack's work.

Jack: Silent again, with no new evidence. His lower fin was replaced by Hana and I don't know why. Earlier he communicated well and his work was clean. Ask him and Hana at the review before rating him. I can't fairly rate him down for something I haven't heard about.

Tentative: Hana is highest on impact and leadership, Sofia highest on collaboration, Omar solid but less impactful, Jack unrated pending the conversation."}
